landing.hero: Your data is messy. Not anymore.
landing.sub: Upload a CSV. Clean it. Visualize it. Ask it questions. Export the report. Five minutes — not five hours.
landing.byline: Built by SKAY · Powered by Claude
landing.smartIngestionBody: CSV, Excel, JSON, Parquet — auto-detected encoding, types, and anomalies.
landing.automatedCleaningBody: 8-step pipeline: normalize, dedupe, impute, validate. One click.
landing.aiAnalysisBody: Ask anything about your data. Claude understands the structure, stats, and patterns.
landing.samplesSub: Three real-world datasets pre-loaded and ready to explore.
landing.howTitle: From chaos to insight in 5 steps
landing.how1Body: Drop any file. AURA detects format, encoding, types, and anomalies automatically.
landing.how2Body: 8 orchestrated cleaners fix names, fill gaps, dedupe rows, and flag outliers.
landing.how3Body: Auto-generated histograms, scatter plots, and a full correlation heatmap.
landing.how4Body: Claude reads your data's structure and answers in natural language.
landing.how5Body: Download a clean CSV or a branded PDF report — one click.
landing.pricingSub: Free forever for personal projects. Upgrade when you need more.
landing.faq1Q: What file formats does AURA support?
landing.faq1A: CSV, TSV, Excel (.xlsx / .xls), JSON, and Parquet. Files up to 100 MB.
landing.faq2Q: Is my data stored on your servers?
landing.faq2A: No. Sessions are in-memory only with a 4-hour TTL. Your data never touches a database.
landing.faq3Q: Which AI model powers the chat?
landing.faq3A: Claude by Anthropic by default. You can switch to OpenAI GPT-4o or a local Ollama model.
landing.faq4A: The frontend and cleaning pipeline run offline. AI Chat and PDF export need a network connection.
landing.faq5A: Yes — the full monorepo is MIT-licensed on GitHub. Self-host it, fork it, extend it.
